    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0] * (3*w) for _ in range(3*h)]

        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if not v: continue
            # Mark center of each input cell. Same-color adjacency extends
            # the mark outward from the neighboring cell's block.
            for dr in range(3):
                for dc in range(3):
                    rr, cc = r + dr - 1, c + dc - 1
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == v:
                        out[3*r+dr][3*c+dc] = v
            # Include the full 3x3 tile at this colored cell's position
            # only when same-color cells touch it orthogonally.
            if r and grid[r-1][c] == v: out[3*r][3*c:3*c+3] = [v]*3
            if c and grid[r][c-1] == v: out[3*r][3*c] = out[3*r+1][3*c] = out[3*r+2][3*c] = v
    return out
''')"
